answer: Written in a systems thinking, emergent properties highlighted register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on token-curated registries for quality signals. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the dune of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the umber of a task receipt, and the tide is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
